title: カウンターバランス式フォークリフト
description: 物流倉庫や街の荷さばき場に配置する着座式フォークリフト。一式に前後で径の異なる四輪、車軸と底部フレーム、後部カウンターウェイト、両側乗降ステップ、座席・操舵輪・ペダルと操作レバー、隙間のある頭上ガードを造形しています。二本の開いたマスト溝、ガイドローラー、静止チェーン、昇降・傾斜シリンダー、荷受けバックレストと低位置の二本のL字フォークを備え、荷物は含みません。全体で一モデル。駆動・昇降・油圧動作、可動リグ、内部エンジン、実機性能・安全性の検証はありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.301 × 2.315 × 3.556 m、43,504三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A seated counterbalance forklift for warehouse yards and urban loading areas. Includes four differently sized front/rear wheels, axles and underside frame, rear counterweight, open entry steps on both sides, seat, steering wheel, pedals and control levers, and a slatted overhead guard. Twin open mast channels, guide rollers, stationary chain detail, lift and tilt cylinders, load backrest and two low-position L-shaped forks are modeled without cargo. The whole assembly counts as one model. No drive, lifting or hydraulic behavior, articulation rig, internal engine, real-machine performance or safety validation is included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.301 × 2.315 × 3.556 m; 43,504 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
